content_sections.heading: ONGC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates interested in ONGC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 must complete the online registration process within the given dates. The registration window will remain open from 05 August 2026 to 18 August 2026.

content_sections.heading: ONGC Medical Officer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for ONGC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 includes qualification-based marks and an interview. Candidates who qualify in the interview will be included in the merit list. The final merit list will be prepared based on the combined marks obtained in qualification and interview. Appointment offers will be issued according to the candidate's position in the merit list.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ONGC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for ONGC Medical Officer Vacancy 2026 by following the steps below: Visit the official ONGC website. Complete the online registration process. Select one eligible post-location combination. Upload the required documents and certificates. Submit the application form before the closing date. The registration portal will be available from 05 August 2026 to 18 August 2026 . Candidates can apply for only one post-location combination based on their eligibility and interest. Recent passport-size colour photograph Photo identity proof such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Driving Licence or Voter ID 10th Board Certificate containing Date of Birth MBBS/BHMS Degree Certificate Educational marksheets Postgraduate Degree/Diploma certificates (where applicable) Registration certificates and other relevant documents

faq.question: Q1. What is ONGC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ONGC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 is a fixed-term recruitment drive conducted by Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd. for Medical Officer, Specialist and Homeopathy Officer posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ONGC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 24 vacancies are available for Medical Officer, Specialist and Homeopathy Officer posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ONGC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to complete the online registration process is 18 August 2026 up to 23:59 hours.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for ONGC Medical Officer Vacancy 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have MBBS, MD/MS, DNB, PG Diploma or BHMS qualifications depending on the post applied for.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ONGC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no maximum age limit for applying for ONGC Medical Officer posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of ONGC Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: The annual CTC ranges from ₹7.80 lakh to ₹15.85 lakh depending on the post and year of engagement.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for ONGC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on qualification marks and interview performance. The total marks are 100, including 70 marks for qualification and 30 marks for interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for ONGC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official ONGC website during the registration period.
